## c09f9e692978

**A-C09-1 — One reproducible held-out-query ambiguity; target unchanged.** Audited generator version `3.0.0`, SHA-256 `38cdf40105db3eaafbf9e4a4fb6557b7ede16bd2052c0f4c2cbd02d76b4243de`, declared/executed rule hash `d74485baf037`.

The 100-per-band census materialized 300 production lessons and 1,200 pairs. Ordered production queries had 0/300 ambiguity, but exhaustive query rotation found 1/1,200 ambiguous rotations. The retained generated lesson uses three demonstrations from source-pair indices `[0, 1, 3]` and holds out index `2`. The declared `border_colour_parity` competitor matches all three demonstrations, then fills four authoritative query cells with 7 where the intended width-parity rule fills 2. The differing zero-based cells are `(1,1)`, `(1,2)`, `(2,1)`, and `(2,2)`.

`checks/audit/c09f9e692978/rotation-counterexample.json` reconstructs the rotated lesson from the report indices and invokes the target’s declared rival directly. `checks/audit/c09f9e692978/rotation-racket.json` is the supported source-bound Racket receipt; it matches the canonical Python mirror and confirms the four-cell disagreement. The query is a production-generated input, so it belongs to the documented domain. The smaller semantic gate found the same class of ambiguity at easy seed `137152185030239`, sample index `22`; the wider census found one at medium seed `2076167305`, sample index `79`.

**Suggested repair.** Ensure every four-pair lesson contains a demonstration that separates width parity from border-color parity at every allowed query position, or keep the curriculum explicitly ordered and mark rotations diagnostic rather than supported.

**A-C09-2 — Portable task tests fail before collection; target unchanged.** `generators/c09f9e692978/tests/test_generator_c09f9e692978.py` sets `ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]` at line 13, reads `ROOT/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl` at line 24, and imports `puzzle_generators.per_puzzle.<task>.generator`. In the staged runtime this resolves beneath the task directory, so preflight reports the canonical path missing and pytest never runs.

**Evidence.** `checks/audit/c09f9e692978/combined/result.json` contains the exact preflight failure and source manifest. Replace the fixed parent guess with `reviewer_support.find_root(__file__)`, use `canonical_pairs`/`canonical_path`, and load the staged selected generator through the public reviewer helper.
